text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eheh! ♪ This lip gloss's so popular that
it's been
sold out forever, but I finally
managed t'snag one!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, don't tell me you went out of
your way to
buy that.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
That color's so last week. This berry
shade is all
the rage now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Get outta town! Agh! Why's everyth'n in
the city
gotta move so fast?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin, having realized how quickly
trends
come and go, becomes a bit
disheartened.
